It was founded by Tarun Mehta and Swapnil Jain in 2013. It manufactures electric scooters, including the [[Ather 450]] series and [[Ather Rizta]]. It has EV manufacturing facilities in [[Whitefield, Bangalore|Whitefield, Bangalore,]] and [[Hosur]], [[Tamil Nadu]]. {{Cite news |date=2023-06-07 |title=Ather Energy rolls out five-year loan plan to fuel EV adoption |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/auto/electric-bikes/ather-energy-rolls-out-five-year-loan-plan-to-fuel-ev-adoption/articleshow/100825547.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-06-24 |issn=0971-8257}}{{Cite web |date=2023-06-02 |title=Ather Energy sells 15,256 e-scooters in May 2023: Highest-ever monthly sales |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/auto/bike-news/ather-energy-sells-15256-e-scooters-in-may-2023-highest-ever-monthly-sales/3111102/ |access-date=2023-06-24 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}} It has also established an electric vehicle charging network across India called Ather Grid. ==History== Ather Energy was founded in 2013 by Tarun Mehta and Swapnil Jain. In early 2014, it received {{INRConvert|4.5|m}} from the Technology Development Board under the Department of Science and Technology, [[IIT Madras|IIT Madras,]] and Srini V. Srinivasan, an IIT alumnus and founder of [[Aerospike (company)|Aerospike]].{{cite news|title=Flipkart founders invest $1 million in Ather Energy|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/flipkart-founders-invest-1-million-in-ather/article6655224.ece|work=The Hindu}} In December 2014, [[Flipkart]] founders, [[Sachin Bansal]] and [[Binny Bansal]], invested $1 million as [[Seed money|seed capital]].{{cite news|title=Flipkart founders lead $1M investment in electric scooter startup Ather Energy|url=https://techcrunch.com/2014/12/03/flipkarts-founders-lead-1m-investment-in-electric-scooter-startup-ather/|publisher=Tech Crunch}} In May 2015, it received $12 million from [[Tiger Global]] for investments in development, testing, production, and the launch of the vehicle.{{cite news|title=Bansals backed Ather Energy raises $12M from Tiger Global|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/bansals-backed-ather-energy-raises-12mn-from-tiger-global-115052901375_1.html|publisher=Business Standard}} On 23 February 2016, the company unveiled its first [[Scooter (motorcycle)|scooter]], the S340, at a technology conference in [[Bengaluru]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.firstpost.com/tech/news-analysis/ather-energy-showcases-s340-indias-first-smart-scooter-at-surge-2016-3677725.html|title=Ather Energy showcases S340, 'India's first smart scooter' at Surge 2016|date=25 February 2016|website=Tech2}}{{cite news|title=5,000+ attendees from 72 countries on their way to SURGE|url=https://surgeconf.com/news/5000-attendees-from-70-countries-on-their-way-to-surge|publisher=SurgeConf}} [[Hero MotoCorp]] invested {{INRconvert|180|c}} in the Series B round of funding in October 2016. It invested again in 2018 to the tune of {{INRConvert|130|c}}.{{cite news|title=Hero MotoCorp To Invest Up To ₹ 205 Crore In Ather Energy|url=http://auto.ndtv.com/news/hero-motocorp-to-invest-rs-205-crore-in-ather-energy-1520809|publisher=NDTV Auto}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.vccircle.com/hero-motocorp-to-refuel-ather-energy-with-19-mn/|title=Hero MotoCorp to refuel Ather Energy with $19 mn|date=2018-07-25|work=VCCircle|access-date=2018-07-30|language=en-US}} In May 2019, Ather Energy raised $51 million in another round of funding, led by [[Sachin Bansal]]'s investment of $32 million. Hero MotoCorp converted its [[convertible debt]] of $19 million as a part of this round. In addition to this, InnoVen Capital extended an $8 million [[venture debt]]. {{Cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2019/05/28/india-ather-energy-51-million-fund/|title=India's Ather Energy raises $51 million to grow its electric scooters business|website=TechCrunch|date=28 May 2019 |language=en-US|access-date=2019-05-29}} In December 2019, Ather Energy signed an [[Memorandum of understanding|MoU]] with the [[Government of Tamil Nadu]] to set up a {{Cvt|400000|sqft||abbr=}} manufacturing plant for electric vehicles in [[Hosur]]. The invested amount will be around {{INRConvert|635|c|lk=0|year=2019}}. {{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/ather-energy-to-set-up-electric-vehicle-manufacturing-facility-at-hosur-in-tn/articleshow/72331050.cms|title=Ather Energy to set up electric vehicle manufacturing facility at Hosur in TN - Times of India|website=The Times of India|date=2 December 2019 |access-date=2019-12-23}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.autocarindia.com/bike-news/ather-450-to-roll-out-of-new-hosur-plant-in-tamil-nadu-415114|title=Ather 450 to roll out of new Hosur plant in Tamil Nadu|website=Autocar India|language=en|access-date=2019-12-23}} The company added two new products to its portfolio, the Ather 450X and the Ather 450 Plus, in January 2020.{{Cite web|title=Ather Energy launches its second e-scooter 450X at Rs 1.5 lakh, enters Delhi market in July|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/sectors/auto/ather-450x-launch-ather-energy-launch-its-second-e-scooter-price-availability/story/394811.html|access-date=2020-08-13|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=28 January 2020 }} In July 2020, Ather Energy raised $11.4 million from Hero MotoCorp as a part of its Series C round funding.{{Cite news|title=Ather Energy gets fresh funding of Rs 84 crore more from Hero MotoCorp|work=Autocar Professional|url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news-national/ather-energy-gets-fresh-funding-of-rs-84-crore-more-from-hero-motocorp-56861}} In November 2020, Ather Energy raised a fresh round of {{INRconvert|260|c}} as a part of the Series D round, led by Sachin Bansal's investment of {{INRconvert|170|c}} and $12 million by Hero MotoCorp. {{Cite news|title=Ather Energy raises Rs 260 crore in latest round of funding|work=Autocar India|url=https://www.autocarindia.com/bike-news/ather-energy-raises-rs-260-crore-in-latest-round-of-funding-419145}} In September 2024, the company filed a DRHP with [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] for a Rs 4,500 crore ($536.2 million) IPO at a valuation of $2.5 billion. The company said it will sell new shares worth $370 million in the IPO as well as up to 22 million shares from existing investors.{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=Manish |date=2024-09-09 |title=EV startup Ather seeks to raise $530 million in India IPO |url=https://techcrunch.com/2024/09/09/ev-startup-ather-seeks-to-raise-370-million-in-india-ipo/ |access-date=2024-09-09 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}} In May 2025, Ather Energy opened its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) and was listed on NSE and BSE.{{cite news |last1=Podishetti |first1=Akash |title=Ather Energy shares slip 5% post flat D-Street debut |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/ather-energy-to-make-its-market-debut-today-check-gmp-ahead-of-listing/articleshow/120915546.cms |access-date=15 May 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=6 May 2025}} == Production and infrastructure == On 2 January 2021, Ather Energy began operations at its production facility in [[Hosur|Hosur, Tamil Nadu]]. {{Cite news|title=Ather Energy Hosur Plant Visit – A Peek into the Future of Electric Scooters in India|work=News 18|url=https://www.news18.com/videos/ivideos/ather-energy-hosur-plant-visit-a-peek-into-the-future-of-electric-scooters-in-india-3518291.html}} The new Ather factory has an annual capacity of 110,000 scooters and 120,000 battery packs. {{Cite news|title=Ather rides on fresh demand for electric vehicles|work=Financial Express|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/auto/electric-vehicles/ather-electric-scooters-ather-450-demand-for-electric-vehicles-electric-bikes-price/2208952/}} The company currently has a presence in 27 cities across 15 states. {{Cite news|title=Inside Ather Energy's Manufacturing Facility: 1 Scooter Built Every 4 Minutes|work=Car and Bike|url=https://www.carandbike.com/news/inside-ather-energys-manufacturing-facility-1-scooter-in-every-4-minutes-2385561}} ==Products== === Ather 450S === The Ather 450S was launched on 11 August 2023, with a 5400-watt [[Permanent magnet synchronous generator|PMSM motor]] that generates a torque of 22 Nm. It offers a range of 115 km and a true range of 90 km on a single charge, and it has a top speed of 90 km/h. It takes 6 hours 36 minutes from 0–80% and 8 hours 36 minutes from 0–100% with a portable home charger. {{cite web |last1=Rao |first1=Rakesh |title=Ather 450S Price, Range, Battery Charging Time, Features & Specifications |url=https://electricindiatoday.com/ather-450s-price-range-charging-time-specifications-features/ |access-date=28 December 2023 |website= |publisher=Electric India Today}} It has features like an [[emergency stop signal]] (ESS), Vehicle FallSafe, a guide-me-on light, Trip Planner, and Theft & Tow Alerts. {{cite web |title=Ather 450S Specifications, Features, Mileage, Weight, Tyre Size |url=https://www.bikedekho.com/ather-energy/450s/specifications |website=BikeDekho |language=en}} ===Ather 450X=== The Ather 450X has a 4G SIM card and Wi-Fi, along with Bluetooth connectivity and the new 7” touchscreen dashboard. It comes with a [[color depth]] of 16 million and a Snapdragon quad-core processor. Ather 450X utilizes [[Android (operating system)|Android Open Source]] to offer map navigation, on-board diagnostics, and features like over-the-air updates, auto-indicator off, and guide-me-home lights. The Ather mobile app offers charging status, push navigation, theft & tow detection, live location & vehicle state tracking, a voice assistant, and welcome lights. The Ather 450X supports connected accessories like smart helmets and [[Tire-pressure monitoring system|tire-pressure monitoring systems]] (TPMS). {{Cite news|title=Ather 450X First Ride Review|work=OVERDRIVE|url=https://www.overdrive.in/reviews/ather-450x-first-ride-review/}} ===Ather 450=== {{main|Ather 450}} The Ather 450 is constructed using an all-aluminum frame, comes with a 3.3 kW/5.4 kW peak (7.2 BHP) [[brushless DC electric motor]], and a 2.4 kWh [[lithium-ion battery]] pack. The scooter can accelerate to 40 km/h in 3.9 seconds, attain a top speed of 80 km/h, and travel 75 km on one charge in city-riding conditions (107 km in the Indian [[driving cycle]]). === Ather Rizta === {{main|Ather Rizta}} The Ather Rizta is a family electric scooter launched in 2024. It comes with a 3.7 kWh lithium-Ion battery pack, which gives a range of 160 km on a full charge with a top speed of 80 km/h and has an acceleration of 0 to 40 km/h in 3.7 seconds. It comes with 34L of storage space. {{cite web | title=Ather Energy - Electric Scooters | url=https://www.atherenergy.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-the-ather-rizta-family-scooter }} ==Other services== ===OTA updates=== Ather Energy provides [[Over-the-air programming|over-the-air]] (OTA) updates for its electric scooters. Ather Energy has rolled out 13 OTA updates as of 2020. {{Cite web|title=OTA Updates|url=https://www.atherenergy.com/ota-updates|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200113064743/https://www.atherenergy.com/ota-updates |archive-date=13 January 2020 }} ===Ather Grid=== Ather has set up its own charging network, dubbed Ather Grid, in 18 cities across India. These [[Charging station|DC-fast-charging stations]] use Ather's proprietary [[Electric car charging methods|charging method]] and connector to charge the Ather scooters at a rate of 1 km/min. The charging points are also equipped with a 3-pin socket to supply AC power to other electric vehicles that do not use Ather's connector. Other vehicles can connect to the charging point and start charging using the Ather Grid app for iOS and Android. {{Cite news|title=Ather Energy unveils its charging infrastructure network AtherGrid|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/ather-energy-unveils-its-charging-infrastructure-network-athergrid/articleshow/64259682.cms|access-date=2021-01-25}} More than 120 fast charging grid points are installed across 18 cities in India. Ather has plans to set up around 300 fast charging stations across India by the end of 2021. Ather also sets up a home charging point at customers' homes, which will charge the Ather 450X overnight. ===Ather Space=== Ather Energy operates Experience Centers through its licensed dealer network. Ather currently has over 175 experience centers in 96 cities in India. [https://press.siemens.com/global/en/pressrelease/ather-energy-selects-siemens-xcelerator-portfolio-speed-development-electric-mobility "Ather Energy selects Siemens Xcelerator portfolio to speed development of electric mobility solutions"] ''Siemens.''
